CustomField.description: Evidence trail of excerpts from the source document(s) showing where non-obvious extracted values came from. Only populated for fields that required inference or deeper search (Total_Contract_Value composed from multiple line items, ARR derivation, Signature_Date choice, Subprocessor_Notice_Period buried in an MSA, Renewal_Terms mapped from customer language, etc.). Trivially-obvious fields (seats, start date, billing email) are not evidenced.
CustomField.label: Extract Evidence
